description: This file defines the MqttPendingSubscription class, which manages MQTT subscription requests, including handling retransmissions, handlers, and subscription state within the Thingsboard MQTT client implementation.

classes.name: MqttPendingSubscription
classes.description: Final class managing pending MQTT subscriptions, including retransmission logic and handler management.

classes.name: MqttPendingSubscription.MqttPendingHandler
classes.description: Record representing a handler associated with the pending subscription, with a flag indicating if it should be invoked once.

classes.name: MqttPendingSubscription.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing instances of MqttPendingSubscription with a fluent API.

methods.name: addHandler
methods.description: Adds a handler to the set of pending handlers with a specified 'once' flag.

methods.name: startRetransmitTimer
methods.description: Starts the retransmission timer if the subscription has been sent, setting up the send packet logic.

methods.name: onSubackReceived
methods.description: Stops retransmission upon receiving a SUBACK acknowledgment.

methods.name: onChannelClosed
methods.description: Stops retransmission when the channel is closed.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new Builder instance for constructing MqttPendingSubscription objects.
